hItems.title: Collingwood
hItems.description: Played at least 1 game for the Collingwood Magpies, or currently on their list.

hItems.title: 20+ DISPOSALS
hItems.subtitle: IN A FINAL
hItems.description: Collected 20 or more disposals in a finals game (since 1965).

vItems.title: 200+ GAMES
vItems.subtitle: SAME CLUB
vItems.description: Played 200 or more games at VFL/AFL level for a single club. Can also have played games for other clubs (including finals).

vItems.title: BRAYDEN MAYNARD
vItems.subtitle: BRAYDEN MAYNARD TEAMMATE
vItems.description: Player has been a teammate of Brayden Maynard.

vItems.title: ALL AUSTRALIAN
vItems.description: Player has made at least one All-Australian team. Includes VFL Team of the Year (1982-90), and All-Australian teams selected after State of Origin carnivals (1953–1988).
